rule:
AB08 mutants of the SPEC0252 rule, one at a time, in the BUILD's own file (scripts/boundary-semantic-engine.mjs of
the worktree): check the committed bytes, apply the exact replacements, run the new suite, restore the bytes
immediately and check them again. Each mutant names the fixture/test that must kill it (SPEC §6 AB08 and build notes
R3-O1..O3; the last three are extra mutants of this BUILD). Writes mutants.json.

mutants.what: busca de strict a partir da própria declaração

replacements.old: for (let a = n.parent; a && !strict; a = a.parent)
replacements.new: for (let a = n; a && !strict; a = a.parent)

namedKillers: SPEC0252 catalog — vN against the base, fixture by fixture (AB02, AB05) C01-own-strict-body
failingSample: SPEC0252 catalog — vN against the base, fixture by fixture (AB02, AB05) C01-own-strict-body
SPEC0252 AB01/AB02 — no false PROVEN the base proved the 26 fixtures of AB01 and the 11 D false PROVEN; vN proves none and roots each in the declaration file
SPEC0252 AB01/AB02 — no false PROVEN no positive is PROVEN in vN (the 37 of AB02 and the 14 D positives)
SPEC0252 AB01/AB02 — no false PROVEN the exact details named by the SPEC (AB02)
SPEC0252 AB04 — the declared cost, exactly only N05–N09 lose a correct PROVEN; no fixture gains PROVEN
SPEC0252 AB06 — controls of the predicate itself the refusal census emits the same tuples
SPEC0252 §5.2 — directive prologue table, file and function-body levels own: single quotes

mutants.what: 'use strict' em qualquer função do arquivo torna o arquivo strict

replacements.new: const fileStrict = strictPrologue(sf.statements, sf) || !!(function any(x) { return (ts.isFunctionLike(x) && !!x.body && ts.isBlock(x.body) && strictPrologue(x.body.statements, sf)) || !!ts.forEachChild(x, any) })(sf)
